about.bioHtml:
Turning 18 is a milestone I'll always remember. Looking back, I'm grateful for all the memories, lessons, and experiences that have shaped me into who I am today. I've faced challenges, made mistakes, and celebrated small victories, and each one has helped me grow stronger and wiser.

As I enter this new chapter of my life, I hope to continue learning, chasing my dreams, and becoming someone my family and I can be proud of. I'm thankful to everyone who has been part of my journey and for celebrating this special day with me.
